The following first class municipol districts, having reolized
on overage onnuol income of more than four thousand pesos for four
consecutive fiscal yeors, ore ipso facto clossified os fifth class
manicipalities pursuont to section two of soid Republic Act Numbered
fifteen hundred and fifteen:
- 3 -
Ditsaon Romain
Watu (Balindong)
MOUNTAIN PROVINCE
Cogayon de Sulu
Pangutoran
South Ubian
This clossification takes effect as of July 1, 1956.
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of February,
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-seven, and of the Inde-
pendence of the Philippines, the eleventh.
(SGD. RAMON MAGSAYSAY
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) FORTUNATO DE LEON
